name: The Call to Command
label: Quest
description: The Call to Command: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The order has come down, adventurer. Varimathras himself has requested that I send my most 'capable' agents back to the Undercity for a highly sensitive tactical operation.
Unfortunately, my most capable agents were killed over three years ago. In their stead I have a collection of brain dead riff-raff.
Travel to the Undercity at once and report to Varimathras. Do not embarrass me, adventurer!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Grand Crusader sits safely in the Scarlet Bastion while his forces pour into your lands, desecrate your structures and monuments and murder your people.
The Dark Lady has commanded that I deal with this insect once and for all. You will become the instrument of the Forsaken's reckoning.
